fresh_semantic_review.ownership: 15 contextual-help prompts and 9 action/correction prompts. The polite “Could you lower ...?” prompt was reclassified from help to action after its first execution because it requests a change; wording was retained.
fresh_semantic_review.result: FAIL — 6/24 cases fail: H02, H07, H10, H11, H12, C07. The harness checks relevant answer text/citations, rejects neighboring-topic instructions, deep-freezes realistic supplied state, and spies on fetch/XHR.
fresh_semantic_review.offline_and_no_mutation: PASS across all 24 cases: no fetch/XHR calls and no supplied-state mutation.

findings.prompt: How do I make the race number art taller and wider?
findings.actual: Cites hdi.recolour_numbers and tells the user to recolour the numbers purple or use Color Replace; it never explains resizing or transforming artwork.
findings.expected: hdi.move_logo guidance for resize/transform of the number layer.
findings.note: The supplied exact wording “scale number artwork” passes; this fresh height/width paraphrase still loses to number-recolour retrieval.

evidence.prompt: Can I turn the car around in this preview and look at its side panels?
evidence.actual: hdi.left_vs_right; instructs drawing separate zones on the flat sheet.

evidence.prompt: Does Shokker have a 3D car viewer where I can orbit the livery?
evidence.actual: Truthfully says the 3D view is unavailable and points to iRacing; passes.

evidence.prompt: Can I inspect the whole car in 3D here, or is this only a flat paint view?
evidence.actual: hdi.load_flat; tells the user to load a TGA/PNG/JPEG.

evidence.prompt: Where do I make the flat paint preview larger without changing the artwork?
evidence.actual: hdi.load_flat; tells the user to load a paint instead of enlarging the preview.

evidence.prompt: Can I rotate the pattern so it runs vertically?
evidence.actual: Correct hdi.rotate_pattern guidance; confirms pattern rotation is distinguishable when explicitly named.

findings.assessment: The limitation is reliable for one orbit/viewer wording. Natural view-around wording can be mistaken for part zoning, and a mixed 3D/flat-view question or a flat-preview-size question is retrieved as paint loading. The explicit 3D detector has narrower verbs/entities than these paraphrases and general HOWTO overlap supplies the wrong topic.

findings.prompt: The finish looks weak after I save and view it in iRacing. What should I check?
findings.contrast: “Why do my paint colors look washed out once the car loads in the sim?” cites hdi.look_differs and gives render/sim troubleshooting.
findings.assessment: The supported symptom vocabulary omits “weak” and the claim patterns require paint/car/shades or a narrow flat/dull construction; “finish ... weak” is missed.

findings.prompt: Everything is too shiny; lower clearcoat on the roof only.
findings.actual: Self-help returns generic “what now” stuck guidance instead of null/action ownership.
findings.assessment: Secondary-command detection only tests each later clause against ORDER_RE. “lower” is not in that verb list, so “too shiny” claims the message as stuck. The protected-exception command “Full vehicle chrome, but do not touch the left side.” correctly remains unclaimed.

findings.actual: 2/13 failures. state() recognizes body.spb-easy-on but not body.spb-chat-studio; with Chat Studio open a PSD layer question gets direct Pro LAYERS steps and omits the visible Full editor transition.

4/5 stale-action checks fail. Pending zone actions preserve numeric indices without a paint/zone identity; an old label can act on a replacement or reordered zone, a removed target can still be reported as done, and refresh can be reported after paint disappears.

scope_limits: The immutable 42-case fixture has only none/flat/psd state labels. The 24-case review supplied realistic Pro state with a flat paint or three-layer PSD and one selected zone, but it did not load the live app.
No production helper, manual, HTML, mirror, frozen fixture, or Wiki file was edited. Only the allowed review test and report were written.
